notes: Each LED branch: Mega pin (2-13) -> jumper -> bottom bank column -> 220 ohm resistor across the centre gap -> top bank column -> LED anode; LED cathode goes into the top ground rail (tn), which a black wire ties to Mega GND. Exact breadboard hole positions are simplified from the image (the image routes cathodes via black jumpers) but connectivity matches the schematic.
Copy k of the repeat uses breadboard column k and Mega pin k+1 (pins 2..13).
Mega GND port name assumed to be GND.1, following the catalogue naming of other boards.
Resistors are 220 ohm and LEDs red, per the manual; all catalogue parts, so no new part types.
